title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Further Strengthening All Trial Work to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantee for Rectifying and Regulating the Order of the Market Economy
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Further Strengthening All Trial Work to Provide Strong Judicial Guarantees for Rectifying and Standardizing the Market Economic Order

Fa [2003] No. 57

To the High People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army, and the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region:

In accordance with the work plan of the Party Central Committee for this year and the guiding principles of the First Session of the Tenth National People's Congress, the State Council has decided to continue vigorously rectifying and standardizing the market economic order as an important task. It recently convened a national conference on rectifying and standardizing the market economic order, which, based on summarizing the work of the previous stage, set forth the work objectives for the next five years and the work priorities for this year. Giving full play to the functional role of the judicial organs, severely punishing criminals who seriously disrupt the market economic order in accordance with the law, lawfully protecting the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations, safeguarding the lawful administration by people's governments at all levels and their relevant administrative law enforcement departments, and providing strong judicial guarantees for rectifying and standardizing the market economic order are extremely important tasks for the people's courts at present and in the period ahead. To this end, notice is hereby given as follows:

1. Fully understand the great significance of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order.

Rectifying and standardizing the market economic order is an important part of establishing and perfecting the socialist market economic system. It concerns the overall situation of the socialist modernization drive and serves the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the people. Since April 2001, the work of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order carried out nationwide has achieved initial results. The chaotic state of the economic order has been preliminarily improved, and the broad masses of the people are basically satisfied. Over the past two years, people's courts at all levels have comprehensively strengthened all trial work, effectively ensuring and promoting the in-depth development of the work of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order. However, chaotic phenomena in the market economic order still exist extensively. Some deep-seated contradictions and problems have not been fundamentally resolved. The task of continuing to rectify and standardize the market economic order remains arduous. Economic crimes and illegal activities such as counterfeiting and shoddy goods, tax evasion, fraud in foreign exchange, commercial fraud, and breach of trust and dishonesty seriously harm the vital interests of the people, even endangering their lives, hinder the expansion of domestic demand and economic development, damage China's international image and opening up, corrupt social credit, and poison social conduct. Therefore, continuing to vigorously rectify and standardize the market economic order is not only an urgent need to ensure the normal operation of the current economy and consolidate and develop the good momentum of the national economy, but also a major measure to establish and perfect the socialist market economic system and comprehensively promote social civilization and progress. It has not only great economic significance but also great political significance. Courts at all levels must, from the height of implementing the spirit of the Sixteenth National Congress of the Party and the important thought of "Three Represents," fully understand the importance, urgency, regularity, and long-term nature of the work of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order, unify their thinking, strengthen leadership, organize and mobilize all judges and other staff members to continue to carry forward the tradition and style of fearing no fatigue and continuous combat, actively engage in the trial work of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order with full political enthusiasm and a high sense of political responsibility, closely cooperate with relevant departments and other judicial organs, ensure that all types of cases brought to court are tried and concluded in a timely manner according to law, and guarantee and promote the smooth progress of this work.

2. Continue to severely punish crimes that seriously disrupt the market economic order in accordance with the law.

Severely punishing various crimes that disrupt the market economic order in accordance with the law is a very important part of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order and is a legal duty that the trial organs should perform according to law. Under the circumstances where illegal and criminal activities in the market economic field still exist extensively, the intensity of criminal punishment must be further increased. Only by maintaining a high-pressure posture can a favorable environment and conditions be created for addressing root causes and standardization work. Courts at all levels must unswervingly implement the policy of severely punishing criminals who seriously undermine the socialist economy in accordance with the law. For criminal cases of seriously disrupting the market economic order that are brought to court, they shall be convicted and sentenced strictly in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law, the decisions and amendments of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress concerning amendments to the Criminal Law, and the judicial interpretations of the Supreme People's Court. This year, priority should be given to cracking down on crimes of manufacturing and selling counterfeit and substandard food, drugs, and agricultural means of production; smuggling; tax evasion, tax resistance, and tax fraud; infringement of intellectual property rights; illegal pyramid selling and disguised pyramid selling; contract fraud and financial fraud, etc. Courts in all localities should highlight the key points of crackdown based on local realities and focus on practical results. Major and important cases involving huge amounts of crime, vile circumstances, serious harm, strong public reaction, and causing significant losses to the interests of the state and the people should be regarded as the top priority, promptly tried, and resolutely severely sentenced. Currently, priority should be given to cracking down on various crimes that disrupt the market economic order by taking advantage of the prevention and control of atypical pneumonia (SARS). For those who take the opportunity to manufacture and sell counterfeit or substandard products for the prevention and control of infectious diseases, produce and sell fake or inferior drugs, or medical devices and medical hygiene materials that do not meet the standards for protecting human health, use the pretext of preventing infectious diseases to publish false advertisements to promote goods and defraud property, take the opportunity to monopolize supply, hoard and profiteer, drive up prices, or commit other crimes that seriously disrupt the market economic order, they shall be resolutely and promptly convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of the Criminal Law.

3. Strictly handle cases according to law, pay attention to reflecting policies, and ensure the legal and social effects of trials.

When trying criminal cases of disrupting the market economic order, courts at all levels must, first, be resolute, second, be prudent, and must ensure accuracy. First, they must strictly distinguish the boundary between crime and non-crime, resolutely exclude interference from local and departmental protectionism, and must both prevent substituting fines for punishment and condoning crime, and prevent treating ordinary administrative violations and civil infringements as crimes for punishment. Second, they must strictly handle cases according to law, conscientiously ensure the pass level for facts and evidence, the application of law, and the trial procedure, guarantee case quality, and improve trial efficiency. Third, they must strictly apply and execute property-related penalties. Where the law provides that a fine or confiscation of property shall be imposed concurrently, such a fine or confiscation of property shall be resolutely imposed; where the law provides that a fine or confiscation of property may be imposed concurrently, generally a fine or confiscation of property shall also be imposed. Currently, courts at all levels should pay special attention to taking measures to change the problem of property-related penalties not being executed or being weakly executed, effectively strengthen the execution of property-related penalties, and maximize their effectiveness in punishing and preventing crime. Fourth, they must strictly implement the principles of legality and proportionality of punishment and the criminal policy of combining punishment with leniency. Those who deserve severe punishment shall be resolutely and severely sentenced according to law; those who deserve leniency shall also be treated leniently according to law. For criminals who, in the process of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order, voluntarily surrender to judicial organs, perform meritorious acts such as reporting and exposing crimes, or have other statutory circumstances for lighter, mitigated, or exempted punishment, they shall be given lighter, mitigated, or exempted punishment according to law in order to divide and disintegrate the criminals.

4. Give full play to the safeguarding role of civil and commercial trial, administrative trial, and execution work in rectifying and standardizing the market economic order.

The civil and commercial trial, administrative trial, and execution work of the people's court directly adjust economic and social relations according to law and are closely related to rectifying and standardizing the market economic order. Civil and commercial cases shall be tried in a timely manner according to law. By adjusting property, credit, and contractual relations among citizens, legal persons, and other organizations according to law, punishing illegal and breaching acts such as infringement of intellectual property rights, fraudulent operation, malicious default or even evasion of debts, fair competition and market order shall be effectively safeguarded, and the legitimate rights and interests of citizens, legal persons, and other organizations and the security of market transactions shall be protected. If suspected economic crimes are discovered during civil proceedings, the matter shall be handled strictly in accordance with the "Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Handling of Economic Dispute Cases Involving Suspected Economic Crimes," and the leads and materials of the suspected crimes shall be promptly transferred to the relevant public security organs or procuratorial organs for investigation and punishment. When trying administrative cases, attention shall be paid to supporting and safeguarding administrative organs in exercising their powers according to law. Specific administrative acts lawfully taken by administrative organs in the course of rectifying and standardizing the market economic order shall be supported and maintained according to law. At the same time, attention shall be paid to protecting the legitimate rights and interests of market entities. For administrative lawsuits filed by citizens, legal persons, or other organizations against administrative organs for failing to perform their statutory duties to protect fair competition, or requesting the competent administrative organs to investigate the legal liability of counterfeiters and sellers of fake goods according to law, the people's court shall accept them promptly and render a fair judgment. Effective measures shall be taken to effectively strengthen execution work. Court judgments and other legal documents that have taken legal effect shall be resolutely executed according to law to ensure that the property rights confirmed by law are truly and timely realized by the right holders, and the legitimate rights and interests of market entities and the order of the market economy shall be effectively maintained.

5. Actively participate in the comprehensive governance of the market economic order in conjunction with trial work.

Rectifying and standardizing the market economic order is a comprehensive systematic project, requiring both short-term measures and long-term solutions. The trial activities of the people's court can play an important role in both addressing symptoms and root causes. While handling cases, courts at all levels should pay attention to discovering loopholes and hidden dangers in management systems and links, timely issue judicial suggestions, remind and urge relevant departments and units to improve systems and strengthen management, and prevent the occurrence of crimes and disputes. The trial of cases related to rectifying and standardizing the market economic order according to law shall be organically combined with promoting legal education on the socialist market economy to the whole society. Attention shall be paid to selecting typical cases with educational significance for public sentencing at the location where the crime occurred or at the unit where the crime was committed, and through news media, using various forms such as explaining the law through cases, widely publicize the law, educate the masses, and enhance the awareness and ability of the whole nation to use the law to protect and safeguard their legitimate rights and interests. Attention shall be paid to vigorously promoting the rule of law and rule of virtue through trial activities, enhancing the concept of law and integrity among the whole people, and fostering a socialist commercial morality of conscious law-abiding and honesty and trustworthiness throughout society. Courts at all levels shall actively cooperate with the Supreme People's Court in supervising major and important cases and publicizing judgment results through central news media. For major and important cases of disrupting the market economic order supervised by the Supreme People's Court, communication and liaison shall be strengthened, and information shall be submitted in a timely manner, strictly in accordance with the requirements of the relevant notice of the Supreme People's Court. Once a case is brought to court, the indictment shall be reported level by level to the Supreme People's Court. Before a case is heard or a judgment is pronounced, the situation shall be reported to the Supreme People's Court. For cases determined by the Supreme People's Court to be publicized and reported, the relevant courts shall actively do a good job in the relevant coordination work. All High People's Courts shall further strengthen the guidance over the supervision of relevant cases within their jurisdiction, grasp the trial progress, keep abreast of the situation, designate a special liaison officer responsible for supervision and reporting, and report the progress of the cases to the Supreme People's Court at the end of each month in a timely manner.

May 6, 2003
